target_hypothesis: The reproducible V0.15 host-environment response branches are stratified at the coarse runtime SIMD level by AVX512F availability rather than by CPU vendor alone; if AVX512F classes are not internally stable or are not independently populated, the factor remains underpowered/confounded and no causal claim is allowed.
object: New independent GitHub-hosted PURE_PAIR evaluations on GRID1024 of the two exact V0.15 replay-failure cells plus the exact GRID1024 anchor, grouped prospectively by runtime AVX512F present/absent and secondarily by exact CPU model. The response remains the signed centered beta response (plus-minus)/(2h).

pre_registered_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: If anchor spread reaches 1e-5, requested-node binding exceeds 1e-12, any lane is missing, any response is non-finite, frozen identity/hash fails, or ephemeral provenance enters the classifier, classify HOST_FACTOR_ISOLATION_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE; no promotion.
pre_registered_decision.NOT_REPRODUCED: If all invariants pass but neither replay-failure cell has cross-job spread >=1e-5, classify V015_HOST_STRATIFICATION_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_V016 and authorize only a new cross-host stratification confirmation audit.
pre_registered_decision.SOFTWARE_CONFOUNDED: If stable OS/kernel/compiler/Python/NumPy/SciPy control signatures are not constant across the sample, classify HOST_FACTOR_ISOLATION_CONFOUNDED_BY_SOFTWARE_CONTROL_VARIATION and authorize only a controlled software-image factor audit.
pre_registered_decision.UNDERPOWERED: If either AVX512F present or absent has fewer than four independent jobs, classify HOST_FACTOR_ISOLATION_UNDERPOWERED_AVX512_CLASS and authorize only expanded prospective replication.
pre_registered_decision.SAME_CPU_MODEL_VARIATION: If any exact CPU-model group with at least two jobs has a replay-failure within-group spread >=1e-5, classify HOST_FACTOR_ISOLATION_INCOMPLETE_SAME_CPU_MODEL_VARIATION and authorize only deeper runtime-state fingerprinting.
pre_registered_decision.AVX512_STRATIFIED: If both AVX512F classes have at least four jobs, all failure cells are stable within each AVX512F class below 1e-5, both failure-cell class means differ between AVX512F present and absent by >=1e-5, software controls are constant, anchors pass, and no same-CPU-model nondeterminism occurs, classify RUNTIME_AVX512_CLASS_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED. This is stratification only, not causality; authorize only a controlled AVX512 dispatch intervention audit.
pre_registered_decision.MIXED: Otherwise classify HOST_FACTOR_ISOLATION_MIXED_OR_CPU_MODEL_REQUIRED and authorize only expanded CPU-model factor replication.

interpretation_ceiling: V0.16 may confirm or reject runtime AVX512F class as a stable coarse stratifier of the already-established host-dependent numerical replay defect, or show that finer CPU/runtime factors are required. It cannot establish causal SIMD mechanism without an intervention, cannot validate full Layer-B, covariance, whitening, nuisance treatment, relation-null, Wm_S3, global traversal, dark-sector inference or any physical signal.
